def runLengthEncode (s : String) (h_precond : runLengthEncode_precond s) : List (Char × Nat) :=
  s.foldl (fun acc ch =>
    match acc with
    | [] => [(ch, 1)]
    | (prev_ch, count) :: tail =>
      if prev_ch == ch then
        (ch, count + 1) :: tail
      else
        (prev_ch, count) :: acc ++ [(ch, 1)]
  ) []
